newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 13.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Jan. 13:

WASHINGTON - Two female Citadel cadets who charged that fellow students harassed them and set their clothes on fire said they will not return to the South Carolina military college for the second semester of their freshmen year.

WASHINGTON - The House ethics committee appeared headed toward a public airing of its charges against House Speaker Newt Gingrich on Friday as GOP leaders accused Democrats of leaking a tape of a telephone conference call to divert attention from President Bill Clinton's problems.

WASHINGTON - A new annual survey of college freshmen portrays a class that is more civic-minded, more self-confident and more supportive of a range of conservative social values than students have been in decades.
WASHINGTON - A surge in crime is prompting many residents of the Takoma Park, Maryland suburb to leave their quiet neighborhood.
SEOUL, SOUTH KOREA - A Seoul man expressed skepticism about the North Korean submarine that ran aground off South Korea last September and now faces up to 1-1/4 years in prison.
